About.title: About
About.name: Kim Anna
bio:
Choreographer and Performance Director with many years of experience in the dance and entertainment industry. She spent many years working in a dance studio, as well as in a music entertainment company alongside artists, trainees, and creative teams.

 She has experience working across a variety of formats, from video shoots and creative productions to concerts, live shows, and stage performances. Comfortable working with both small groups and large-scale teams.

In addition to creating choreography, she develops performance concepts, stage visuals, and other creative solutions. She especially enjoys the creative side of the process — generating ideas, building the overall concept of a project, and refining the details that help make each performance more cohesive and engaging.

 Previously, she served as the director of a show ballet team in Kazakhstan and is currently the leader of the dance team THE PARADOX.
